findings.summary: The header injection check (assertValidHeaderValue) was removed, so CR/LF in header values is silently stripped instead of throwing. Callers lose the fail-fast signal, and existing tests that expect a throw will fail.

judge.reason: Describes the known problem that header values are silently rewritten instead of rejected, not the Unicode-stripping bug.

findings.summary: INVALID_HEADER_VALUE_CHARS_RE silently deletes all characters above 0xFF and DEL. Non-Latin text such as '日本' or emoji is corrupted without any error, where Node would previously have thrown.

judge.reason: Identifies that characters above 0xFF are silently deleted when the header is set, which is the b1 defect.

findings.summary: NO_PROXY now treats localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 as equivalent, so listing one loopback form bypasses the proxy for the others. This departs from exact-match semantics, and the matching is asymmetric (::ffff:127.0.0.1 is not covered).

judge.reason: This is the known loopback-equivalence change in shouldBypassProxy.
